scope: Static analysis of retained response bytes only; no captured JavaScript was executed and no remote requests were made.
coordinate_unit: UTF-16 code units; lines are one-based and columns zero-based
limitations: Dynamic expressions are placeholders, not evaluated values.
Endpoint and route literals are candidates; static presence does not prove invocation or authorization.
Numeric factory identities are lexical containing properties, not an independently verified module graph.
CSS is retained and verified but not parsed for additional imports.
Only top-level successful GET captures classified as HTML, JavaScript or CSS are indexed.
